games.headline: Luka Doncic powers the Lakers past the Hawks, stretching the win streak to 6
games.desc: — Luka Doncic had 32 points, eight rebounds and 10 assists and the Los Angeles Lakers extended their winning streak to six games with a 124-114 win over the Atlanta Hawks on Monday night.

games.headline: Grayson Allen scores 27, Naz Reid adds 25 as Hornets beat Cavaliers 124-112 to snap 6-game skid
games.desc: — Grayson Allen scored 27 points, Naz Reid added 25 points and 13 rebounds and the Charlotte Hornets beat the Cleveland Cavaliers 124-112 on Monday night to snap a six-game losing streak.

games.headline: Collins puts up 24 points and 10 rebounds as Pistons beat Davis and Wizards, 122-111
games.desc: — John Collins had 24 points and 10 rebounds as the Detroit Pistons beat the Washington Wizards 122-111 on Monday at Little Caesars Arena.

games.headline: Jerome scores 27 points as Grizzlies improve to 5-0 on road by routing short-handed Raptors 118-102
games.desc: — Ty Jerome scored 27 points, Cameron Boozer added 22 and the Memphis Grizzlies improved to 5-0 on the road this season by beating the short-handed Toronto Raptors 118-102 on Monday night.

games.headline: Flagg has 43 points, 10 rebounds, Irving 35 points in Mavericks' 125-122 win over Pacers
games.desc: — Cooper Flagg had 43 points and 10 rebounds and Kyrie Irving scored 35 while completing a back-to-back for the first time this season as the Dallas Mavericks rallied past the Indiana Pacers 125-122 on Monday night.

games.headline: Durant and Sengun power the Rockets past the Nuggets 110-100 to snap a 2-game skid
games.desc: — Kevin Durant had 23 points and Alperen Sengun added 20 to lead the Houston Rockets to a 110-100 win over the Denver Nuggets on Monday night that snapped a two-game skid.

games.headline: Wembanyama has 40 points, 9 blocks as Spurs win 9th straight with 122-96 victory over Suns
games.desc: — Victor Wembanyama scored 40 points, grabbed 11 rebounds and blocked nine shots in another dominant performance to help the San Antonio Spurs beat the Phoenix Suns 122-96 on Monday night.

games.headline: Stephen Curry, Brandin Podziemski each score 25 as Warriors run away from Pelicans for 138-87 win
